title: GitHub - tommyjepsen/repliflow: Node-based orchestration of video and image generation based on Replicate
excerpt: Node-based orchestration of video and image generation based on Replicate - tommyjepsen/repliflow
content_html:
A node canvas for generating images, video, audio and 3D with Replicate. Wire a prompt into a model, wire that model's output into the next one, and keep the whole chain on one canvas instead of in a folder of downloads.

npm install
npm run dev

Then add your Replicate API token via the key icon in the left rail. Grab one at replicate.com/account/api-tokens. It is kept in localStorage and never leaves your machine except as the Authorization header on proxied API calls.

The canvas

Right-click the canvas to open the node menu — search across the whole catalog, or drill into Image / Video / Audio / 3D / Utility → group → model, plus local Effects. The bottom toolbar switches between select and pan, adds nodes, fits the view, and zooms.

There are four kinds of node:

  • Prompt holds text. The Start from a template dropdown appends a written-out starting prompt — photography, illustration or motion — rather than replacing what you already typed. Drag its right handle into a model node to feed it.
  • Image is your own image: upload a file or paste a URL. Uploads stay local.
  • Model shows the model's real inputs, runs the prediction, and previews the result inline (image, video, audio player, 3D download, or text). If a price is known it is shown next to the name, and the model page is one click away.
  • Effect applies a local pixel transform — see below.

Each media input on a model node has its own target handle, so you can drop an edge straight onto image or last image and control first-frame/last-frame wiring explicitly. When a prompt node is connected, the model node still offers a small Add to it field: what you type there is sent as the connected prompt plus your addition on a new line, so one prompt can drive several variants.

Chaining works by output type: an image node feeds anything with an image input, an audio node feeds a lipsync model, a captioning model's text feeds a prompt input, and so on.

Starter templates

An empty canvas offers a few pre-wired graphs instead of a blank page — prompt → image, prompt → video, image → image (Flux Kontext), image → video (Kling), generate then cut the background out, and a cheap video test that iterates prompts on Wan before you pay for Veo or Sora. They are defined in src/lib/templates.ts.

Effects

The Effects section of the node menu holds local image transforms — halftone, ASCII, dither, pixelate, posterize, duotone, scanlines. These are deterministic pixel operations, so they run on a canvas in the browser rather than as predictions: instant, free, and repeatable. Parameters re-apply live as you drag them.

Because reading pixels needs a same-origin image, effect nodes work from the cached blob rather than the delivery URL. Each effect node keeps one asset (re-running overwrites it) so tweaking a slider doesn't flood the gallery. Feeding an effect result back into a Replicate model works — the blob is converted to a data URI on the way out.

Add one in src/lib/effects.ts: a name, a parameter list, and an apply that draws to a canvas.

Projects

Projects are stored in IndexedDB and autosave about half a second after you stop editing. The Projects panel in the left rail switches, creates, duplicates, renames and deletes them; the last opened project reopens on launch.

Generated files are downloaded and cached as blobs alongside the project, because Replicate's delivery URLs expire roughly an hour after a run. If that download is blocked, the node falls back to the remote URL and the preview will break once it expires.

Gallery and saving files

The Gallery panel lists every generation newest-first, scoped to all projects or just this one, with previews, re-download and delete.

Auto-download can be toggled there. By default files land in your normal downloads folder; in Chromium you can instead nominate a folder once and everything is written into a repliflow/ subfolder inside it. A plain <a download> cannot target a subfolder, so this uses the File System Access API and falls back to an ordinary download elsewhere (src/lib/fs.ts).

Sharing and backing up a canvas

The Projects panel copies the canvas as a single pasteable share code, or writes it to disk as a <project>.repliflow.json file — the Download button for the open canvas, the hover icon on any row for the others. The import button in the left rail takes either back in: paste the code, or open the file. Only the structure travels — prompts, model choices, settings and edges — never generated output or local asset keys, which mean nothing on another machine. Uploaded images are dropped too; a remote URL survives. Models or effects the receiving build doesn't know about are skipped and reported rather than failing the import, and every field is validated because a share code is untrusted input (src/lib/share.ts). The downloaded file is the same graph as readable JSON, so it is diffable and hand-editable; it goes to your nominated folder if you have one, otherwise to your normal downloads.

Account and usage

The usage panel reads your Replicate account and recent predictions: run count, compute time, success/failure split, activity over the last day and week, and your most-used models. Replicate's API exposes no billing or cost data, so spend is not shown — there is a link to your billing page instead of a guess.

Model inputs are fetched, not hardcoded

src/lib/models.ts only records a model's slug, menu placement, and what it outputs — roughly 190 curated models across image, video, audio, 3D and utility. The actual input fields come from the model's OpenAPI schema on Replicate, fetched and normalized at runtime by src/lib/schema.ts. So the knobs on a node always match the live model, and adding a model is a one-line change.

The schema also decides which input receives an upstream connection: fields with format: uri are classified as image / video / audio by name, and the matching upstream node fills them.

Pricing is the one thing that can't be fetched — Replicate publishes no rates through its API and model pages render them client-side — so a small hand-maintained table in models.ts labels the models it knows, and everything else shows nothing rather than a guess.

Stack

  • Vite + React 19 + TypeScript
  • Tailwind v4 with shadcn/ui conventions (components.json, @/components/ui)
  • @xyflow/react for the canvas, zustand for graph and project state, TanStack Query for account and usage reads
  • Light, dark and follow-the-system themes, cycled from the left rail

The Replicate proxy

api.replicate.com sends no CORS headers, so the browser cannot call it directly. The Vite dev server proxies /replicate/* to it (see vite.config.ts). A production deployment needs an equivalent server-side proxy — the static dist/ build alone will not reach the API.

Predictions are created against a model's latest_version when one is published, and against the model-scoped endpoint otherwise (official models do not expose versions). See src/lib/replicate.ts.

sentences.en: Only the structure travels — prompts, model choices, settings and edges — never generated output or local asset keys, which mean nothing on another machine.

sentences.zh: 接收构建不知道的模型或效果将被跳过并报告，而不是使导入失败，并且每个字段都会经过验证，因为共享代码是不受信任的输入（src/lib/share.ts）。

sentences.en: The downloaded file is the same graph as readable JSON, so it is diffable and hand-editable; it goes to your nominated folder if you have one, otherwise to your normal downloads.

The actual input fields come from the model's OpenAPI schema on Replicate, fetched and normalized at runtime by src/lib/schema.ts. So the knobs on a node always match the live model, and adding a model is a one-line change.

content_html_zh:
用于通过复制生成图像、视频、音频和 3D 的节点画布。 将提示连接到模型中，将该模型的输出连接到下一个模型中，并将整个链保留在一个画布上，而不是保存在下载文件夹中。

npm install
npm run dev

然后通过左侧栏中的钥匙图标添加您的复制 API 令牌。 请访问replicate.com/account/api-tokens 获取一个。 它保存在 localStorage 中，并且永远不会离开您的计算机，除非作为代理 API 调用上的授权标头。

画布

右键单击画布打开节点菜单 - 搜索整个目录，或深入查看图像/视频/音频/3D/实用程序 → 组 → 模型，以及局部效果。 底部工具栏在选择和平移之间切换、添加节点、适合视图和缩放。

节点有四种：

  • 提示包含文本。 从模板开始下拉列表会附加书面的开始提示（摄影、插图或动作），而不是替换您已经输入的内容。 将其右手柄拖动到模型节点中以为其提供数据。
  • 图片是您自己的图片：上传文件或粘贴 URL。 上传保留在本地。
  • 模型显示模型的真实输入、运行预测并预览内联结果（图像、视频、音频播放器、3D 下载或文本）。 如果价格已知，它会显示在名称旁边，并且只需单击一下即可进入型号页面。
  • 效果应用局部像素变换 - 见下文。

模型节点上的每个媒体输入都有自己的目标句柄，因此您可以将边缘直接放到图像或最后一个图像上，并显式控制第一帧/最后一帧连线。 当连接提示节点时，模型节点仍然提供一个小的“添加到它”字段：您在其中键入的内容将作为连接的提示加上新行上的添加内容发送，因此一个提示可以驱动多个变体。

链接按输出类型进行：图像节点通过图像输入提供任何内容，音频节点提供口型同步模型，字幕模型的文本提供提示输入，等等。

入门模板

空画布提供了一些预先连线的图表，而不是空白页面 - 提示→图像、提示→视频、图像→图像（Flux Kontext）、图像→视频（Kling）、生成然后剪切背景，以及一个廉价的视频测试，在您支付 Veo 或 Sora 之前在 Wan 上迭代提示。 它们在 src/lib/templates.ts 中定义。

效果

节点菜单的“效果”部分包含本地图像变换 - 半色调、ASCII、抖动、像素化、色调分离、双色调、扫描线。 这些是确定性的像素操作，因此它们在浏览器的画布上运行，而不是作为预测：即时、免费且可重复。 当您拖动参数时，参数会重新实时应用。

由于读取像素需要同源图像，因此效果节点从缓存的 blob 而不是传递 URL 工作。 每个效果节点都会保留一个资源（重新运行会覆盖它），因此调整滑块不会淹没图库。 将效果结果反馈回复制模型是可行的——blob 在输出时被转换为数据 URI。

在 src/lib/effects.ts 中添加一个：名称、参数列表和绘制到画布的应用。

项目

项目存储在 IndexedDB 中，并在停止编辑后约半秒自动保存。 左侧轨道中的“项目”面板可切换、创建、复制、重命名和删除它们；最后打开的项目在启动时重新打开。

生成的文件会作为 blob 与项目一起下载并缓存，因为 Replicate 的传送 URL 在运行后大约一小时就会过期。 如果该下载被阻止，节点将回退到远程 URL，预览一旦过期就会中断。

图库和保存文件

图库面板按最新顺序列出每一代，范围涵盖所有项目或仅此一个，并提供预览、重新下载和删除。

可以在那里切换自动下载。 默认情况下，文件位于您的普通下载文件夹中；在 Chromium 中，您可以指定一个文件夹一次，然后所有内容都会写入其中的 repliflow/ 子文件夹中。 普通的 <a download> 无法定位子文件夹，因此它使用文件系统访问 API 并回退到其他地方的普通下载 (src/lib/fs.ts)。

共享和备份画布

“项目”面板将画布复制为单个可粘贴共享代码，或将其作为 <project>.repliflow.json 文件写入磁盘 - 打开画布的“下载”按钮，其他行的悬停图标。 左侧导轨中的导入按钮可以返回：粘贴代码，或打开文件。 只有结构移动——提示、模型选择、设置和边缘——永远不会生成输出或本地资产密钥，这在另一台机器上没有任何意义。 上传的图片也会被丢弃；远程 URL 仍然存在。 接收构建不知道的模型或效果将被跳过并报告，而不是使导入失败，并且每个字段都会经过验证，因为共享代码是不受信任的输入（src/lib/share.ts）。 下载的文件与可读的 JSON 是相同的图，因此它是可比较的并且可手动编辑；如果您有指定文件夹，它将转到您指定的文件夹，否则将转到您的正常下载。

账户及使用情况

使用面板读取您的复制帐户和最近的预测：运行计数、计算时间、成功/失败划分、过去一天和一周的活动以及您最常用的模型。 Replicate 的 API 不公开任何计费或成本数据，因此不会显示支出 — 有一个指向您的计费页面的链接，而不是猜测。

模型输入是获取的，而不是硬编码的

src/lib/models.ts 仅记录模型的 slug、菜单位置及其输出内容 - 大约 190 个涵盖图像、视频、音频、3D 和实用程序的精选模型。 实际的输入字段来自模型在 Replicate 上的 OpenAPI 架构，由 src/lib/schema.ts 在运行时获取并规范化。 因此，节点上的旋钮始终与实时模型相匹配，并且添加模型只需一行更改。

该架构还决定哪个输入接收上游连接：格式为 uri 的字段按名称分类为图像/视频/音频，并由匹配的上游节点填充它们。

定价是无法获取的一件事——Replicate 不通过其 API 发布任何价格，并且模型页面将它们呈现在客户端——因此 models.ts 中的一个手工维护的小表标记了它所知道的模型，而其他所有内容都只是猜测。

Stack

  • Vite + React 19 + TypeScript
  • Tailwind v4 具有 shadcn/ui 约定（components.json、@/components/ui）
  • @xyflow/react 用于画布，zustand 用于图形和项目状态，TanStack 查询用于帐户和使用情况读取
  • 浅色、深色和跟随系统主题，从左栏循环

复制代理

api.replicate.com 不发送 CORS 标头，因此浏览器无法直接调用它。 Vite 开发服务器代理 /replicate/* 到它（参见 vite.config.ts）。 生产部署需要等效的服务器端代理 - 单独的静态 dist/ 构建将无法到达 API。

预测是在发布模型时针对模型的latest_version 创建的，否则针对模型范围的端点创建的（官方模型不公开版本）。 请参阅 src/lib/replicate.ts。
